title: Extension discovery and tool descriptor validation

claims.text: load imports the extension package and visits its child modules in sorted name order, collecting their TOOLS, VALIDATORS and FOLDS.
load raises a RegistryError for duplicate tools, validators or folds. _descriptor checks ToolSpec metadata and preflights the object input_schema.
Registry.__post_init__ copies input schemas and exposes read-only maps for tools, validators and folds.

decision.rule: Change here when extension discovery order, descriptor validation or ownership of tool, validator and fold maps needs to change.
decision.failure: An extension import fails, a descriptor or schema is rejected, or a tool, validator or fold name is registered twice.

questions.q: Where does Registry load discover extensions and reject duplicate ToolSpec registrations?
Where should I change validation of a tool descriptor input_schema before registry discovery succeeds?
Where can I debug duplicate_validator or duplicate_fold while loading extensions?
